pages.title: Block Ray
pages.text:
Length (double) -> Ray (Block) -> Coordinate
Pops ray length, shoots ray along line of sight, pushes center coordinate (Vec3) if block is hit.

pages.title: Entity Ray
pages.text:
Length (double) -> Ray (Entity) -> Entity List List
Pops ray length, shoots ray along line of sight, pushes list containing all entities hit along path.
Mana cost = 0.4105 * (e^(0.16*distance) - 1). When distance < 16, mana cost is negligible; when distance > 16, mana cost increases rapidly.
